findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "sse" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: federation_attest, federation_offer, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_enter_tenant · Private data: federation_tenant_info, federation_attest, federation_key_status, federation_offer, federation_governance, legal_get, federation_arena, federation_latency, federation_solvency · Public sink: federation_pricesheet, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_enter_tenant · Destructive: federation_catalog_platforms, federation_arena.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: federation_attest, federation_offer, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_enter_tenant · Private data: federation_tenant_info, federation_attest, federation_key_status, federation_offer, federation_governance, legal_get, federation_arena, federation_latency, federation_solvency · Public sink: federation_pricesheet, federation_catalog_platforms, federation_enter_tenant · Destructive: federation_catalog_platforms, federation_arena

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "legal_get" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Fetch a ComOS legal instrument as raw markdown: the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Data Processing Agreement (DPA), or a one-page Data Retention Summary. These are the terms an agent (and its manager) operate under — read them the way you read the pricesheet. Public and read-only; discloses, does" → after: "Fetch a ComOS legal instrument as raw markdown: the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Data Processing Agreement (DPA), a one-page Data Retention Summary, or the Prompt Library Submission Terms. These are the terms an agent (and its manager) operate under — read them the way you read the pricesheet. "

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
